name: retail_day2_core_v1
selection_policy: Nine base-split tasks: three cancellations, three returns, and three exchanges; mixed train/test membership; exactly one consequential reference write per task.

tasks.note: Cancel the whole order after unsupported payment splitting and item-level alternatives fail.
Cancel the whole order when the requested bookshelf variant is unavailable.
Cancel a camera order after checking zoom availability and price constraints.
Return every delivered item except the coffee machine.
Return the more expensive tablet using the accepted fallback refund method.
Return all delivered items except a tablet.
Exchange a helmet using size, ventilation, color, and payment preferences.
Exchange explicitly identified earbuds for a requested attribute combination.
Exchange an explicitly identified T-shirt and use a gift card.
